production_path.feature_extraction: load_reference_grounding tokenizes the raw brief and JSON summaries
production_path.input_object: request.brief (raw str); hard_constraints, soft_preferences, and other request fields are not passed
production_path.invocation_timing: once before CharacterGenerationAgent construction and before generation
production_path.selected_reference_semantics: final deterministic pre-generation top-k inserted into generation context and mirrored in generation audit

review_packet.instruction: Human/model review only; null values are intentional and are not machine relevance labels.

selector.scoring: sum(1 for brief token present in tokenized JSON reference summary)
selector.tie_breaking: ascending reference_id after descending total score

summary.overlap_metric: Jaccard(selected top-k sets) across all pairs of the 12 broad cases

selection_concentration.metric: HHI = sum((reference selected top-k slots / all selected slots)^2)
